hypothesis: The M1144 objective pass is strong enough to admit a guarded actor-update design, but not an actor update or PPO.
success_criteria: supported and unsupported claims are explicit
no actor training, PPO, replay, objective optimization, corpus build, mining, promotion, or private holdout occurs
